main.description: A community-side member record granting a user roles within the community. Lives on the community repo and is written when an admission is finalized.

roles.description: Role record-keys assigned to this member on the same community repo.

nickname.description: Optional per-community display-name override for this member.

fromMembership.description: Optional AT-URI of the user's `social.colibri.membership` declaration this admission was based on.
